thread:
customer-zoe: Hey team — starting 14:30 UTC we saw a spike of 429s and very high tail latencies from our EU users. We have region=pinned: eu-west in our API calls but the response headers show x-region: us-east and x-fallback: true. Can someone help? We also got unexpected cross-region billing for those requests.
jess_support: Thanks Zoe — can you paste a sample request + response headers and a request-id? I can open a ticket while eng looks.
customer-zoe: sample below (sanitized):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." 
 -H "X-Region: eu-west" 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-open-6b","input":"hi"}'

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Request-ID: req_2026_0001
X-Region: us-east
X-Fallback: true
X-Queue-Position: 38
X-Billed-Region: eu-west
Content-Type: application/json
```
We can provide full request ids if needed.
jess_support: filing ticket #INC-12345, tagging eng-oncall. Adding customer billing note to escalate finance.
cheng_runtime: I pulled req_2026_0001 trace — the router marked eu-west as overloaded and triggered the automatic fallback policy. Two things stand out: 1) our queueing/backpressure metric for eu-west is being treated as "eligible to spill" for pinned customers (shouldn't be), and 2) autoscaler didn't spin up new workers because the scale metric is latency_p50 which is not increasing while requests sit queued (we only measure service latency post-dequeue). This creates a cold-shard handshake timeout + spillover loop.
maria_oncall: Confirmed. Hotshard eu-west-1/shard-7 at 96% mem and 98% GPU util. Queue length 400 (avg 1.2s per token but long wait). Autoscale shows no recent events due to the metric gap.
nate_infra: Looks like an unfortunate interaction between router policy and customer pinning. The router's policy allows spillover when capacity_exhausted==true regardless of customer_pin; we intended to guard pinned customers with allow_spillover=false but that flag isn't being evaluated for some legacy pinned tokens. I'll patch the router but need to coordinate a safe rollout.
customer-zoe: Is there a short-term mitigation? We can't have EU users routed to US (latency kills ux) and the billing is noisy.
cheng_runtime: Short-term options: 1) enable temporary capacity in eu-west (add a few dedicated slots) — Nate can do this, 2) flip the feature flag to disable spillover for pinned customers (requires rollout), OR 3) honor header `X-Force-Region: eu-west` in router to bypass spillover if present (we can push a small change). Which do you want?  
nate_infra: I can spin up 4 extra instances in eu-west now (estimated 6 minutes to be warm). I'm also prepared to do a quick flag rollout: flip `router.reject_spillover_for_pinned_customers=true` at 10% then 100% if health is OK. That flag will stop routing pinned traffic to other regions entirely.
maria_oncall: Recommend immediate capacity + flag rollout. Also we should suspend automatic billing attribution until we sort this (finance will need an incident credit if cross-region billing occurred).
jess_support: Zoe — will you accept those steps? We can also offer a temporary credit scope pending investigation.
customer-zoe: Please do capacity + flag. Also want confirmation on refunds later.
support-bot: Ticket INC-12345 updated: assigned to eng-runtime and infra. Priority: high.  
nate_infra: Starting instance provisioning now, ETA ~6m. Will post when healthy.
cheng_runtime: I'll prepare a tiny router patch to honor `pinned_customer` flag and ensure `allow_spillover` is checked. Plan: 1) deploy to canary host group, 2) monitor fallback_count and p50/p95 routing latency for 15m, 3) ramp to 100% if ok.
maria_oncall: I see the new instances coming up, GPU warmup in progress. If the queue drains we can hold on version rollout. Monitoring: eu-west queue length, fallback_count, and cross-region egress bps.
nate_infra: eu-west extra instances healthy at +4, queue length dropping from 400 -> 90 in 4m.
cheng_runtime: Canary router patch deployed to 10% — no bounce observed and fallback_count for pinned tokens is 0 on canary. I'll keep it at 10% for 15m.
jess_support: Customer updated: appreciate fast response. Asking about refund process; I've created FIN-456 for finance to review cross-region billing for the above request-ids.
customer-zoe: Thanks all, seeing latency improve. Please confirm when fully rolled.
maria_oncall: Rolling router patch to 100% now (gradual). Watching for errors.  
nate_infra: Done. All routed pinned traffic now stays in eu-west. Queue nearly back to normal (~12). No new cross-region markers.
cheng_runtime: Follow-ups: 1) We'll change autoscaler to use queued_request_count as a scale input OR expose a separate backpressure metric so scale triggers when queue grows, 2) add an alert and daily metric for "pinned_customer_fallback_count" so product/ops can catch regressions early, 3) add regression test to ensure pinned tokens never spill when capacity is degraded (should return 503 rather than cross-region route).
jess_support: Noted. I'll close the customer-facing loop once finance confirms billing review. Thank you everyone. :thumbsup:
support-bot: INC-12345 status -> resolved (pending finance credit).
